title: Cyd Stumpel: talks and recognitions as tagged rows
note: On About, 'Conferences & meetups' and 'Recognitions' are rows: small red pill tags (conference, meetup, city, date) above a 20px Instrument Serif title, a thin red rule, and a ticket button or + on the right to expand. Dense but very scannable, and the pills carry the colour instead of images. Worth reusing for an experience list: meta as small tags above a big, readable title, with details hidden behind a +.
